main.content:
{{Item Infobox |id = 110281 |image = Item Four Phases, Crossing the River to Check the King.png |type = Trace Material |type2 = Light Cone Ascension Material |invCategory = Upgrade Materials |rarity = 2 |effect = |description = A four-sided die used for simple checks. Can slightly level up Traces for {{Color|h|Destruction}} characters. |bg_desc = The benefit of a four-sided die is that, if you believe in it, it will make every problem easy.
Complex dilemmas, unsolvable games, and all those situations you have no idea how to handle — the hard part of it all lies in "not knowing what the optimal solution is." We spend our whole lives with a desire to grasp the power to select, yet spend that same lifetime feeling the anxiety of potential regret.
But a four-sided die doesn't need to think about any of that. There is no optimal solution in the life of a die. In other words, in a die's life, all four sides are the optimal solution. |mentions = Asat Pramad |source1 = [[Calyx (Crimson): Bud of Destruction (Inkford Hermitage)|Calyx (Crimson): Bud of Destruction]] |source2 = [[Embers Exchange]] |source3 = [[Omni-Synthesizer]] — Material Exchange }} {{Description|''"So don't overthink it. No matter what you select, [[Asat Pramad|I]] will declare it: a great success."''}} '''Four Phases, Crossing the River to Check the King''' is a 2-star [[Trace Material]] and [[Light Cone Ascension Material]] for the path of [[Destruction]]. ==Sold By== {{Shop Availability}} ==Synthesis Usage== {{Craft Usage}} ==Ascension Usage== {{Ascension Usage}} ==Trace Usage== {{Trace Usage}} ==Trivia== * "Crossing the River to Check the King" refers to the river in {{w|xiangqi}} (Chinese chess), which marks the boundary between the two sides of players. ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Four Phases, Crossing the River to Check the King |zhs = 四相，过河照君 |zht = 四相，過河照君 |ja = 四相、過河照君 |ko = 사상, 도하장군 |es = Brillo del cruce real |fr = Quatre phases : Reflet du roi sur le fleuve |ru = Четыре стороны света: Переход поля, шах королю |th = Four Phases, Crossing the River to Check the King |vi = Tứ Tướng, Qua Sông Chiếu Tướng |de = Vier Phasen: Flussüberquerung zum König |id = Four Phases, Crossing the River to Check the King |pt = Quatro Fases, Cruzar o Rio e Dar Xeque no Rei }} ==Change History== {{Change History|4.3}} ==Navigation== {{Upgrade Material Navbox}} [[ru:Четыре стороны света: Переход поля, шах королю]]

Can moderately upgrade the Traces of {{Color|h|Destruction}}characters. |bg_desc = Once cast, the result of a six-sided die cannot be defied. The thrower "chooses" to cast it, and it brings a "result." But this is not the end, as the cycle of cause and effect has only just begun.
